title: Celestia Fibre · My validator
description: Your Celestia Fibre server as the Cumulo Fibre Network Monitor sees it, from the public Fibre API.

options.content: Your Fibre server, as the Cumulo Fibre Network Monitor sees it: checked every minute from four regions (US, EU, CA, AS). Pick the network and paste your validator's valcons at the top. Every panel reads the free public Fibre API (no key, about 12 requests per refresh). Full profile and history on cumulo.pro.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Your Fibre server right now: Ready (majority of probe regions), Partial (some regions only), Not ready, No host (no Fibre host registered) or Unknown when the monitor has no verdict (never shown as a failure). Then uptime 24h/7d/30d, typical round trip, days until the identity certificate expires and active warnings.

"Ready" : status = "partial" ? "Partial" : status = "offline" ? "Not ready" : status = "no_host" ? "No host" : "Unknown", "up24": uptime.h24, "up7": uptime.d7, "up30": uptime.d30, "typical": typical_rtt_ms, "certdays": identity_expires_at ? $floor(($toMillis(identity_expires_at) - $millis()) / 86400000), "warnings": $count(warnings)}); $exists($r) ? $r : [])

panels.title: Signs and keeps the data
panels.description: Signs: blobs signed out of those you could sign (publishers stop at 2/3, so less than 100% is expected). Keeps: retention checks served for blobs you signed. 24h / 7d / 30d; empty when there was no blob or check in that window.
